module.purpose: Provides the router's store abstractions and constructs the coordinated store set used to expose router status, locations, route identifiers, and route matches.
module.summary: This module defines readable and writable store contracts, non-reactive server-side store implementations, and a router store factory. The factory maintains atomic router state, derives aggregate matches and compatibility state, caches stable per-route stores, and batches membership and match updates so departures publish lane changes before tombstones.
module.businessContext: Supports client and server routing state management. Failures can desynchronize displayed locations, loading status, or route matches from the active route tree.
classes: RouterReadableStore (~L9-11): Read-only abstraction for retrieving a current store value
RouterWritableStore (~L13-17): Readable store extended with value and updater mutations
RouterStores (~L62-79): Coordinated router state stores and per-route match access
functions: createNonReactiveMutableStore (~L41-51): Creates an SSR-compatible mutable in-memory store
createNonReactiveReadonlyStore (~L54-60): Creates an SSR-compatible store that reads on demand
createRouterStores (~L81-171): Builds coordinated router state, derived stores, and match updates
getMatchStore (~L110-117): Retrieves or creates a stable store for one route match
setMatches (~L144-168): Batches route membership and match-store synchronization

detail.name: createNonReactiveMutableStore
preconditions: An initial value of type TValue is provided.
postconditions: Returns a RouterWritableStore<TValue> whose get() initially returns initialValue.
A subsequent set() makes the supplied value or updater result the current store value.
invariants: The store's current value is held privately by the returned store closure.
get() returns the most recently assigned value.
A functional update receives the current value and its result becomes the new current value.
edgeCases: The initial value may be any TValue, including a falsy value; get() returns it unchanged.
Setting a direct value replaces the current value.
Setting an updater function applies it to the current value and stores the returned result.
stateMutations: Mutates the private closure-local current value when set() is called.
detail.summary: Creates a mutable, non-reactive store initialized with the supplied value. The store exposes access to the current value and supports replacement or functional updates.

specTests.when: Create the store and call get() before any set() call
Call set(previous => previous + 3), then call get()

units.name: createNonReactiveReadonlyStore

detail.name: createNonReactiveReadonlyStore
preconditions: read is a callable function returning TValue.
postconditions: The returned store is readonly and non-reactive.
invariants: The store does not mutate caller-provided state.
The store preserves the TValue type parameter of the read function.
edgeCases: If read returns an undefined or otherwise boundary TValue value, the store preserves that returned value according to TValue.
Repeated reads reflect the behavior of the supplied read function.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback behavior is specified; errors from the supplied read function propagate when it is read.

detail.summary: Creates a non-reactive readonly router store whose value is supplied by the provided read function. The returned store is intended for server-side rendering and does not establish reactive behavior.

units.name: createRouterStores

detail.name: createRouterStores
preconditions: config provides createMutableStore, createReadonlyStore, and batch implementations compatible with StoreConfig.
postconditions: Returns a RouterStores<TRouteTree> containing status, location, resolvedLocation, ids, matches, byRoute, __store, getMatchStore, and setMatches.
The status store is initialized to 'idle'.
The location store is initialized with initialLocation.
The resolvedLocation store is initialized to undefined and the ids store is initialized to an empty array.
The matches and __store values are derived from the underlying stores.
Per-route match stores are created lazily and retained in byRoute.
invariants: The matches derived store follows the order of route IDs in ids.
The __store derived value exposes status, isLoading, matches, location, and resolvedLocation; isLoading is true exactly when status is 'pending'.
A given route ID maps to a stable match store for the lifetime of the returned store collection.
Updates performed by setMatches are batched through config.batch.
edgeCases: When getMatchStore is called for a route ID not present in byRoute, a mutable match store is created with an initial value of undefined and returned.
When getMatchStore is called repeatedly for an existing route ID, the existing match store is returned.
When setMatches receives an empty array, ids becomes empty and previously present route match stores receive undefined when their IDs leave the set.
When route IDs change, ids is published before tombstone updates are sent to stores for routes that left the set.
When a route match is supplied to setMatches, its route ID is included in ids and its corresponding per-route store is updated with that match.
stateMutations: Creates and initializes the status, location, resolvedLocation, ids, matches, and __store stores.
Mutates the private byRoute map when a previously unseen route ID is requested.
The returned setMatches operation mutates ids and per-route match store values.
detail.summary: Creates the router's reactive state stores, derived stores, per-route match stores, and update operations. The returned store collection is initialized from the supplied location and keeps route membership and match values synchronized through batched updates.

Status value that determines the __store isLoading projection.

specTests.then: The returned collection has status initialized to 'idle', location initialized to the supplied location, resolvedLocation initialized to undefined, ids initialized to [], and matches initially derived as [].

specTests.then: Both calls return the same per-route store, whose current value is undefined.

specTests.when: setMatches is called with those matches.
specTests.then: The ids store contains the matches' routeId values in input order, and each corresponding per-route match store contains its supplied match after the batched update.

detail.name: setMatches
preconditions: nextMatches is an array of route match objects containing routeId values.
postconditions: The next route IDs are derived from nextMatches in array order.
The route-ID store is updated when the previous and next route-ID arrays differ.
Each route ID present previously but absent from nextMatches has its route-specific store set to undefined.
invariants: All membership and removed-route updates occur within a single batch.
Route departures are processed only for IDs absent from the next route-ID list.
edgeCases: An empty nextMatches array produces an empty next route-ID list and clears each previously present route store.
When the previous and next route-ID arrays are equal, the route-ID store is not updated.
A route ID that remains present in nextMatches is not cleared as a departed route.
stateMutations: The route-ID store is updated when membership changes.
Route-specific stores for departed route IDs are set to undefined.
detail.summary: Synchronizes the non-reactive route-match stores with the supplied route matches. It publishes route-ID membership changes before clearing stores for routes that have departed.

specTests.when: setMatches is called with matches whose route IDs are ["a"].
specTests.then: The route-ID store is set to ["a"], and the store for route ID "b" is set to undefined within the batch.
The route-ID store is not updated because the ID arrays are equal, and route ID "a" is not cleared as departed.
